Xbox Saves Kojima's Physint from PlayStation Cancellation - IGN Daily Fix
recentItems.description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Hideo Kojima's upcoming spy project, Physint, is moving from PlayStation to Xbox. Announced by Kojima, the move was apparently due to Physint's potentially cancellation by Sony, who may have been scared off by Death Stranding 2's low sales compared to the original. Xbox has now signed a publishing deal with Kojima Productions, and will now be publishing both Physint and the upcoming horror game, OD. In other news, Nintendo is giving back to their fans—sort of—by way of a sale discounting select games, hardware, and accessories like amiibo. The sale is due in part to tariff refunds Nintendo had received.
